rules.headings: Uppercase only. Use tracking-widest (e.g., tracking-[0.2em]) to emulate tech displays.
rules.data_readouts: Use JetBrains Mono at tiny scales (text-[10px] to text-xs) for logs, timestamps, and coordinates.
rules.hierarchy: H1: text-5xl tracking-[0.3em], H2: text-2xl tracking-[0.2em] text-cyan-400, Body: text-sm text-cyan-50/70

colors.rules: No pure white backgrounds. Everything is deep black with glowing cyan structural lines and amber highlights.

visual_enhancers.scanlines: MANDATORY: Add a fixed full-screen overlay with pointer-events-none: bg-[linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,0)_50%,rgba(0,0,0,0.25)_50%)] bg-[length:100%_4px].
visual_enhancers.vignette: MANDATORY: Radial gradient shadow from edges to center to increase cinematic depth.
visual_enhancers.glows: Use drop-shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(0,240,255,0.6)] for active elements, reactors, and critical text.
visual_enhancers.hud_brackets: Do not use standard border-radius cards. Containers must use L-bracket corners (border-t-2 border-l-2 border-cyan-500/50 w-4 h-4 absolute top-0 left-0, etc.) to look like camera viewfinders.

layouts.structure: Symmetrical Command Deck. 100vw 100vh overflow-hidden absolute positioning.
layouts.center_stage: Giant Circular Arc Reactor. Houses the voice visualizer, AI state, and central node. Must dominate the middle 40% of the screen.
layouts.left_rail: Dense technical readouts. System diagnostics, real-time memory logs (scrolling monospace text), and mini-radar/Second Brain overview.
layouts.right_rail: Command Stream. Current active notes, chat inputs (styled as terminal commands), and actionable Amber buttons.
layouts.density: HIGH. Fill empty spaces with micro-data, coordinates, rotating crosshairs, and progress rings to sell the 'Iron Man HUD' illusion.

motion.reactor_spin: Multiple concentric SVG rings rotating at different speeds, alternating clockwise and counter-clockwise.
motion.pulse: Smooth opacity pulsing (0.4 to 1.0) on the cyan core to simulate 'breathing' AI.
motion.data_stream: Fast text scrambling on load before settling into readable words.
motion.hover: Elements don't lift; they increase their text-shadow/glow intensity and switch from Cyan to Solid White or Amber.

components.modals_and_overlays: CRITICAL: NO TRANSPARENT BACKGROUNDS for content surfaces. Use bg-black/90 backdrop-blur-xl border border-cyan-500/30. Ensure text is 100% readable over the complex background.
components.buttons: Terminal style. Transparent background, 1px solid cyan border, uppercase cyan text. On hover: bg-cyan-500/20 text-white shadow-[0_0_15px_#00F0FF].
components.inputs: Border-bottom only (border-cyan-500), bg-transparent, monospace font, blinking block cursor.
components.second_brain_graph: Render using react-force-graph-2d. Nodes must be glowing cyan (standard) and amber (focused). Links must be glowing semi-transparent lines.

instructions_to_main_agent.step_1: Setup global CSS for Scanlines, Grid Background, and Glowing utility classes.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_2: Build the Central Reactor component using concentric absolute-positioned SVGs with framer-motion rotations.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_3: Build the HUD Layout: Left Rail (Logs/Graph), Center (Reactor/Voice), Right Rail (Commands/Notes).
instructions_to_main_agent.step_4: Implement the Second Brain visual graph with react-force-graph-2d.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_5: Skin all Shadcn components (Dialog, Input) to strip their SaaS look entirely, replacing it with the HUD Bracket/Terminal aesthetic.
instructions_to_main_agent.critical_note: This is a single-screen dashboard. Use raw HTML/Tailwind for the grid to maintain strict absolute/relative positioning. Avoid standard flexbox document flow where possible to maintain the camera HUD illusion. Work in .js files, NOT .tsx.

accessibility.contrast: Maintain high contrast for readable data by using white or bright cyan text against the void black background.
accessibility.animations: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the spinning reactor rings.

testing_attributes.requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute. Use kebab-case, role-based names (e.g., data-testid='reactor-activate-btn').

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur), but NEVER purely transparent content surfaces.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles (in this case, terminal/HUD style) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use technical SVG icons from lucide-react or phosphor.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable, but heavily customize them for the HUD look.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js.
